name: Wild Solo Weekend, Rooted Path Experiences
summary: A solo weekend in the forest on a fixed schedule of hard hikes and recorded spoken prompts, with check-in calls to our facilitators. Some outdoor experience needed. $190.
description:
Rooted Path Experiences offers a structured solo weekend for those ready to go deeper into their relationship with the land.

**Your weekend**
You will follow a carefully designed schedule. Dawn: a spoken-reflection practice using our audio prompts, in which you answer aloud. Morning: a demanding hike on one of our marked routes (8 to 14 miles, significant elevation). Afternoon: a second reflection session. Evening: a check-in call with one of our facilitators, who will help you process the day. Each day is planned for you.

**Our facilitators**
Our facilitators have many years of experience guiding people on the path and are trained in our methods. They will be available by phone at set times throughout your weekend.

**Who this is for**
Those with some backcountry experience who want to challenge themselves physically and be guided by our facilitators' approach.

**Cost**
$190, including the camp site, route cards, and facilitator calls.
practical: Friday evening to Sunday afternoon, May to October. $190. One participant per site. Bring all camping gear, food, and water filter; a list is sent. Trailhead directions sent after booking. Satellite messenger provided for facilitator calls.
